notes: The first representative run passed all five tests. There were no new course test failures to isolate. The original PDF was visually complete but had five pages, with two pages carrying only two remaining questions.

Only the print break before section C was removed. All 28 questions, four examples, eight example answers, 51 writing lines, 32px line height and fonts remained unchanged. The affected print test passed and the final four PDF pages were rendered and inspected. Both engines then completed the full 15-test course suite on the revised version.

Full course engines ran as two independent processes, one worker each. Unit/workflow checks and the two sequential builds overlapped the end of the WebKit full course run. Chromium account mounts ran in parallel, one worker each, after both course runs completed.

WebKit account mounts ran sequentially with one worker. No other browser test runner was active during that matrix. Normal authenticated in-app preview, cover checks and GIF file inspection took place during that account matrix; these did not submit answers or modify reward state.

All account tests use account-test-version.json. Course implementation and test files were unchanged during the matrix. Source documentation additions after full-test-version.json do not change runtime content; the account snapshot includes those files.
Catalog and deployment checks ran after the account matrix. Representative and print refinement runs are repeated conditions and are not added to the 66 distinct successful conditions.

The two real downloaded GIFs were decoded across all 60 frames. Name, title, scene and paper regions remain stable; the account tests separately verify changing star effects. Actual downloaded frame, one-star comparison and long-name mobile card were visually inspected.

The existing local demonstration account stayed at zero stars and word page 1/3. The new course was reached through the normal directory after preview restart. Four cover widths were inspected, then the default viewport restored. No learning data was cleared.
